limits: Read-only physical byte comparison against fetched remote tree plus phase3 review digests, not a functional proof. git diff against the remote before index reconciliation misleadingly marks untracked-but-present remote files deleted; NONE may be removed.
publicationStrategy: Preserve every remote tree entry in index (git read-tree without -u); stage only reviewed phase2/3/4 changes; commit-tree with publishedAnchor parent; compare-and-swap fixed session branch ref; ordinary fast-forward push, never force/reset/clean/checkout/merge/deploy.
